cause: Training/serving skew on f3 from a missing log transform at serving time. Joining the two feature groups on entity_id (platform-side, Trino delta catalog) showed f1, f2, f4, f5 match exactly (mean abs diff = 0) while f3 diverges (mean abs diff ~8.19). The relationship is exact across all 200 shared entities: training_f3 = log1p(serving_f3) = ln(1 + serving_f3), i.e. serving_f3 = exp(training_f3) - 1 (max residual ~6e-7, floating-point noise). The training pipeline applied a log1p transform to f3 before storing it, but the online serving path serves the raw, untransformed f3. The model therefore sees log-scaled f3 in training and raw f3 at inference.
